newsitem.title: GERMANY: German state inflation data due next week.
newsitem.headline: German state inflation data due next week.

text.p: The statistics offices of the German states of Baden-Wuertemberg, Bavaria, Hesse and North Rhine-Westphalia will probably publish their March inflation data next Tuesday or Wednesday, they said on Friday.

The North Rhine-Westphalia office said there was an outside chance that it might be ready to release the data on Monday, while the Bavarian office said its data might be delayed until Thursday. --Frankfurt Newsroom +49 69 756525
